sops.title: Standard check-in
sops.kw: check in, check-in, arriving guest, new guest, registration

steps.t: Greet the guest within 10 seconds, even if you're on the phone.
Ask for a physical driver's license or passport and the credit card in the same name. Scan the ID in {ID scanner}.
In PEP: Search Reservations > open the reservation > Check In. Work through Welcome, Verify Guest Details, Room Assignment and Payments.
steps.hk: In HotelKey: Search Reservations > open the reservation > Check In. Work through Welcome, Verify Guest Details, Room Assignment and Payments.

steps.t: Have the guest initial and sign the Reg. Card and fill in the vehicle box.
Room Keys panel > Make New Key. Hand over the key packet and parking pass (expires {Parking pass days} after check-out).
Tell them breakfast is {Breakfast hours}, the pool is open {Pool hours}, the Wi-Fi network is {Wi-Fi network}, and check-out is {Check-out time}.
Point to the elevator and wish them a good stay.

sops.script: "Welcome to {Hotel welcome name}! Can I see your ID and the card you'd like on file?"
sops.flag: The ID or card doesn't match the guest, or PEP won't let you check in. Call {AGM}.
sops.flag_hk: The ID or card doesn't match the guest, or HotelKey won't let you check in. Call {AGM}.

sops.title: Preparing arrivals ahead of time
sops.kw: prepare arrivals, pre assign, pre-key, reg cards, arrival bucket

steps.t: Review the arrivals list and count how many of each room type you need.
Assign vacant clean rooms in PEP: open the reservation > Stay tab > Assign.
steps.hk: Assign vacant clean rooms in HotelKey: open the reservation > Stay tab > Assign.

steps.t: Read the comments and requests on each reservation and honor what you can.
Print the Reg. Cards and highlight the initials box, vehicle box and both signature lines.
Pre-make keys and paperclip the key packet to the matching Reg. Card.
Write a parking pass that expires {Parking pass days} after the check-out date and clip it on.
File each prepared card in the arrival bucket.

sops.title: Early check-in, room not ready
sops.kw: early check in, check in early, room ready, room not ready, arrived early

steps.t: Standard check-in is {Check-in time}. Check the housekeeping status for a clean, inspected room of the booked type.
If one is ready, check the guest in. Before 12 PM when occupancy is above 70%, there's a {Early check-in fee} early check-in fee.
PEP blocks check-in on a dirty room. Only mark it Ready for Guest after housekeeping has inspected it.
steps.hk: HotelKey blocks check-in on a dirty room. Only mark it Ready for Guest after housekeeping has inspected it.

steps.t: If nothing is ready, offer to hold their bags and take a cell number.
Ask housekeeping on {Housekeeping chat app} to prioritize that room type, then text the guest when it's ready.

sops.script: "Your room isn't quite ready yet. I can hold your bags and text you the minute it is."
sops.flag: The guest is upset about waiting past {Check-in time}. Call {AGM}.

sops.title: Guest arrives with no reservation (walk-in)
sops.kw: walk in, walk-in, no reservation, need a room, availability tonight

steps.t: Check tonight's availability in PEP (Availability in the sidebar).
steps.hk: Check tonight's availability in HotelKey (Availability in the sidebar).

steps.t: Quote the best available rate, plus Honors, AAA or other discounts they qualify for.
steps.hk: Quote the best available rate, plus AAA or other discounts they qualify for.

steps.t: Offer an upgrade if a better room type is open.
Ask for a physical driver's license or passport and a credit card in the same name. The guest must be 21 or older.
Dashboard > Walk In, then book and check in as normal.

sops.script: "We do have rooms tonight. Tonight's rate is $___. Are you a Hilton Honors member?"
sops.script_hk: "We do have rooms tonight. Tonight's rate is $___."
sops.flag: The hotel is sold out or close to it. Call {AGM}.

sops.title: Can't find the reservation
sops.kw: cant find reservation, no reservation found, missing booking, confirmation number, wrong hotel

steps.t: In PEP: Search Reservations. Type "/" and search by guest name, confirmation number or room number.
steps.hk: In HotelKey: Search Reservations. Type "/" and search by guest name, confirmation number or room number.

steps.t: Try other spellings, the last name only, and the name of whoever booked it.
Widen the dates and include the Canceled status.
Ask for the confirmation email. Check it's for {Hotel location check}.
For a third-party booking, check the Expedia or Booking.com extranet.

sops.script: "Let me look a little further. Do you have your confirmation email handy?"
sops.flag: It's booked through a site you can't find, or the hotel has no room for them. Call {AGM}.

sops.title: Reservation is for the wrong date
sops.kw: wrong date, wrong day, booked wrong night, arrived early, arrived late

steps.t: Confirm the dates on the guest's confirmation.
If they're early and it's a direct booking, change the dates in PEP: Stay tab > click the date > adjust NIGHTS > Save > Confirm.
steps.hk: If they're early and it's a direct booking, change the dates in HotelKey: Stay tab > click the date > adjust NIGHTS > Save > Confirm.

steps.t: If they missed their arrival, check the No Show / Late Cancel tile. Reinstate only works on the current business date.
Explain any rate change before you confirm.
Third-party bookings must be changed through the site they booked on.

sops.script: "It looks like the reservation is for a different night. Let me see what I can do."
sops.flag: A no-show was already charged and the guest wants it removed. Call {AGM}.

sops.title: Guest has no photo ID
sops.kw: no id, no photo id, forgot id, lost id, id required

steps.t: The guest must show a physical ID. Only a driver's license or passport is accepted.
Photos of an ID, expired IDs and other ID types are not accepted.
The only exception is a Hilton Honors Diamond member.
steps.hk: Skip this step at this hotel.

steps.t: If they can't provide one, politely explain you can't check them in.

sops.script: "I'm sorry, we need a physical driver's license or passport to check in."
sops.flag: The guest becomes upset or insists. Call {AGM}.

sops.title: Guest is under the minimum check-in age
sops.kw: under 21, minimum age, too young, age requirement, 18 year old

steps.t: The minimum check-in age is 21.
Someone 21 or older must be staying and must be added as an additional guest (PEP: Guest tab > Additional Guests).
steps.hk: Someone 21 or older must be staying and must be added as an additional guest (HotelKey: Guest tab > Additional Guests).

steps.t: Scan that person's ID in {ID scanner}.
Sometimes the manager may allow an exception. Ask before you say yes.

sops.script: "Our policy requires a guest who is 21 or older on the reservation."
sops.flag: The guest asks for an exception. Call {AGM}.

sops.title: Name on the ID doesn't match the reservation
sops.kw: name doesnt match, wrong name, booked by someone else, different name

steps.t: Ask who made the reservation.
If someone else booked it, the guest staying must still show their own ID.
If someone else is paying, the cardholder must complete a {Card authorization tool} credit card authorization form.
Update the reservation to the actual guest's name before you check in.

sops.script: "Who made the reservation for you? I just need to match it to your ID."
sops.flag: You think the card or booking may be fraudulent. Call {AGM}.

sops.title: Guest has no credit card
sops.kw: no credit card, no card, pay with cash, cash only, debit

steps.t: The guest must have a valid credit card in their name that matches their ID.
If they don't, the cardholder (who is not present) must fill out a {Card authorization tool} credit authorization form.
The hotel is cashless. Cash can't be used for the room or the deposit.
Don't check in until payment is secured.

sops.script: "We need a card in your name. If someone else is paying, I can send them a quick authorization form."
sops.flag: The guest can't provide any card. Call {AGM}.

sops.title: Card declines at check-in
sops.kw: card declined, card declines, payment failed, card not working

steps.t: Say it quietly: "That card didn't go through."
Any other card they try must be in the name on their ID.
No check-in is allowed until payment is collected.
If the guest is part of a group, reach out to the sales director.

sops.script: "That card didn't go through. Do you have another card in your name we could try?"
sops.flag: The guest has no other card or becomes upset. Call {AGM}.

sops.title: Local resident wants a room
sops.kw: local resident, local guest, lives nearby, local address

steps.t: There are no extra restrictions for local residents.
The guest must be 21 or older with a physical ID and a card in their name.
Check them in as normal.

sops.title: Guest wants to see the room first
sops.kw: see the room, look at room, view room, show room

steps.t: This is allowed only if another manager or team member can watch the desk or escort the guest.
Never hand the guest a key on their own.
Walk them up, show the room, and walk back down together.

sops.script: "I'd be happy to show you. Let me get someone to cover the desk."

sops.title: Room type requested isn't available
sops.kw: room type not available, wanted king, wanted two queens, sold out room type

steps.t: Check PEP for any room of that type that can be cleaned quickly.
steps.hk: Check HotelKey for any room of that type that can be cleaned quickly.

steps.t: Offer a comparable room type, explaining the difference.
If you move them to a better type at no charge, use Room Type > Complimentary Upgrade.
Note the request in Stay Remarks for the next night if they're staying longer.

sops.script: "We don't have that room type available tonight, but I can offer you ___."
sops.flag: The guest refuses every option. Call {AGM}.

sops.title: Guest asks for an upgrade
sops.kw: upgrade, better room, suite, bigger room

steps.t: Check what's available for every night of the stay.
Quote the paid upgrade rate for the better room.
Honors Gold and Diamond members get space-available upgrades per Hilton standard. Offer one when available.
steps.hk: Skip this step at this hotel.

steps.t: In PEP: Stay tab > Room Type > Next (charged) or Complimentary Upgrade.
steps.hk: In HotelKey: Stay tab > Room Type > Next (charged) or Complimentary Upgrade.

sops.script: "I can upgrade you to a ___ for $___ more per night."

sops.title: Late arrival after the audit has run
sops.kw: late arrival, arrived after audit, no show showed up, reinstate

steps.t: Look for the reservation on the No Show / Late Cancel tile.
If the check-in date is today's business date, open it > Reinstate > Confirm.
If not, rebook it with Actions > Copy Reservation from the No Show tile.
Check in as normal and make sure the night is posted correctly.

sops.flag: The guest was charged a no-show and wants it removed. Call {AGM}.

sops.title: Arrival calls at 9 PM
sops.kw: arrival calls, eta, call arrivals, 9pm calls

steps.t: Around 9 PM, call every guest still in arrivals.
Ask for an estimated time of arrival.
Note each ETA in {Log book app} so night audit knows who's coming and whether to hold the audit.

sops.script: "Hi, this is {Hotel name}. We're looking forward to seeing you tonight. Do you know about what time you'll arrive?"

sops.title: Calling HLD guests around 5 PM
sops.kw: hld, hold reservations, guarantee, no card on file, 5pm calls

steps.t: Around 5 PM, pull up reservations on hold (HLD) without a card.
Call each guest and ask for a card to guarantee the room, or send a {Card authorization tool} link.
Note the result on the reservation.

sops.script: "I'm calling to guarantee your reservation for tonight. Could I get a card for the room?"

sops.title: Guest arrives and the hotel is oversold
sops.kw: oversold, overbooked, walk guest, no rooms left, sold out

steps.t: Reach out to the MOD before you tell the guest anything.
Find a nearby hotel with availability.
Follow the walk procedure the MOD gives you: book the other hotel and arrange how the guest gets there.
Apologize sincerely and log it in {Log book app}.

sops.script: "I'm very sorry. We're full tonight, and I've arranged a room for you nearby."
sops.flag: Always: call {AGM} before walking any guest.

sops.title: Digital Key guest
sops.kw: digital key, phone key, app key, honors app key not working

steps.t: Digital Key guests check in and get their key in the Hilton Honors app.
If the key isn't working, reissue the digital key.
Ask the guest to check for pending Hilton Honors app updates.
If it still fails, make a physical key after checking ID.

sops.script: "Let me reissue your digital key. Could you also check the Honors app for an update?"

sops.title: Multiple rooms for one party
sops.kw: multiple rooms, two rooms, family rooms, rooms together, link reservations

steps.t: Book together with New Booking and set the number of rooms. Room 1's guarantee copies to the others.
If booked separately, link them: Actions > Linked Reservations > Link New Reservation.
Assign rooms near each other when possible.
If one card pays for all, set that up before check-in.

sops.title: Guest checking in for someone else
sops.kw: check in for someone, picking up keys for, someone else's room

steps.t: Only guests on the reservation can get keys.
The person checking in must show their own ID and be added to the reservation.
If the person paying isn't there, they must complete a {Card authorization tool} credit authorization form.

sops.script: "I can help as soon as you're added to the reservation."

sops.title: VIP or GM-flagged arrival
sops.kw: vip, special guest, owner, gm guest

steps.t: Check reservation remarks and {Log book app} for VIP notes before the guest arrives.
Pre-assign the best available room of their type and have it inspected.
Set up any welcome amenity the manager requested.
Let {AGM} know when the guest arrives.

sops.title: Standard check-out
sops.kw: check out, checkout, leaving, departure, receipt

steps.t: In PEP: Departures > open the reservation > Folio tab.
steps.hk: In HotelKey: Departures > open the reservation > Folio tab.

steps.t: Review the charges with the guest. The balance must be $0.00.
Check Out > check "All folios are balanced" > Confirm Check Out.
Offer to email the folio.
Ask how their stay was and thank them.

sops.script: "How was everything with your stay? I'll email your receipt."
sops.flag: The guest disputes a charge you can't fix. Call {AGM}.

sops.title: Express or Digital Key check-out
sops.kw: express checkout, express check out, digital checkout, left keys in room

steps.t: Guests can leave keys in the room; the folio is emailed.
To set it up: reservation Guest tab > Guest Actions > Express Check Out on.
Departures > Express Check-Out. Everything on the Qualified tab is ticked by default; untick anyone you don't mean to check out > Confirm.
Fix anything on the Not Qualified tab by hand (balances, refunds due).

sops.title: Vacant rooms during check-out
sops.kw: vacant rooms, checked out rooms, tell housekeeping, whatsapp vacant

steps.t: As each room becomes vacant, pull its Reg. Card from the bucket and file it in the checked-out tray.
Text the housekeeping {Housekeeping chat app} group which rooms are vacant.
Print a vacant clean list and match it to today's arrivals.

sops.title: Late checkout request
sops.kw: late check out, late checkout, stay later, extend checkout, leave later

steps.t: Check-out is {Check-out time}.
Look at tonight's occupancy and whether housekeeping can still finish every room on time. Reach out to housekeeping before you approve.
Limit how many late checkouts you give. With teams, if one member gets it the rest will ask too.
After {Late check-out cutoff}, a full night is charged unless a manager waives it.
Update the departure time in PEP and tell housekeeping.
steps.hk: Update the departure time in HotelKey and tell housekeeping.

sops.script: "I can give you until ___. After {Late check-out cutoff} we do have to charge a full night."
sops.flag: The guest wants past {Late check-out cutoff} without the charge. Call {AGM}.

sops.title: Departures still in house after 11:15
sops.kw: still in room, past checkout, overstay, didnt check out

steps.t: After 11:15 AM, call each room still on the departures list.
If there's no answer, knock with a second team member and announce yourself.
If they need more time, follow the late checkout rule: full night after {Late check-out cutoff} unless a manager waives it.
If the room is empty but belongings remain, tell {AGM} before anything is packed up.

sops.script: "Good morning, this is the front desk. Check-out was 11. Will you be needing a few more minutes?"
sops.flag: Belongings are left behind or the guest won't leave. Call {AGM}.

sops.title: Guest wants to leave early
sops.kw: leave early, early departure, checking out early, cut stay short

steps.t: Check the rate type. Prepaid and advance purchase rates usually can't be refunded.
The current night can be refunded if they check out before {Check-out time}.
In PEP: Stay tab > change the Check-Out Date > Confirm > Confirm.
steps.hk: In HotelKey: Stay tab > change the Check-Out Date > Confirm > Confirm.

steps.t: Actions > Early Check-Out Flow. Waiving the early departure fee needs a manager override.
All refunds go to a manager first.

sops.script: "I can check you out today. Let me see what applies to your rate."
sops.flag: The guest wants the fee waived or a refund. Call {AGM}.

sops.title: Guest wants to extend the stay
sops.kw: extend stay, stay longer, another night, extra night, add nights

steps.t: Check availability for the added nights.
Direct booking: Stay tab > Check Out date > add NIGHTS > Save > read the new cost > Confirm.
OTA booking: create a separate reservation. Actions > Copy Reservation, pick the new dates and rate.
Collect payment from the guest and insert the payment into the terminal.
Make new keys with the new departure date.

sops.script: "I can add those nights. The rate for the extra nights is $___."

sops.title: Guest disputes a charge on the folio
sops.kw: dispute charge, wrong charge, didnt order, overcharged, folio error

steps.t: Open the Folio tab and find the charge.
If it's clearly a posting error, fix it: select the charge > Adjust > Adjustment Code > Remarks > Confirm.
If it's a fee the guest disagrees with (smoking, damage, pet), don't remove it yourself.
Log what happened in {Log book app}.

sops.script: "Let me take a look at that charge with you."
sops.flag: The guest disputes a fee or asks for money back. Call {AGM}.

sops.title: Guest needs a receipt after leaving
sops.kw: receipt, folio, email receipt, invoice, copy of bill

steps.t: Find the reservation and check for an email on file.
Confirm with the guest that the email is correct.
Folio tab > Email All Folios (Net View or Detailed View) > Send.
OTA prepaid reservations: only the incidental folio may be emailed, not the room charges.
Never read card numbers over the phone.

sops.script: "I'll email that to you right now. Can you confirm your email address?"

sops.title: Guest skipped (left without paying)
sops.kw: skipped, skip, left without paying, didnt pay, walkout

steps.t: Confirm the room is empty and the guest is gone.
Charge the balance to the card on file: Folio tab > Payment.
Note any damages with photos.
Write an incident report.

sops.title: Damage or smoking found after check-out
sops.kw: damage, smoking, smoked in room, broken, stained, smoke fee

steps.t: Get photos from housekeeping and maintenance notes.
Post the fee: Folio tab > Charge. The smoking fee is {Smoking fee}.
Email the guest the photos of the damages.
Mark the guest DNR in PEP (DNR tab > DNR Code > remarks > Mark DNR) and in {DNR system}.
steps.hk: Mark the guest DNR in HotelKey (DNR tab > DNR Code > remarks > Mark DNR) and in {DNR system}.

sops.flag: Before posting any damage charge, check with {AGM}.

sops.title: Lost and found
sops.kw: lost and found, left behind, forgot item, lost item, found item

steps.t: Log the item in PEP: More > Lost and Found > Add Found Item.
steps.hk: Log the item in HotelKey: More > Lost and Found > Add Found Item.

steps.t: Store it securely with the date and room number.
Reach out to the guest and see if they'd like it shipped back.
Wallets, jewelry, electronics and IDs go to a manager to store.

sops.script: "We found your ___. Would you like us to ship it to you?"

sops.title: Day use / same-day check-out
sops.kw: day use, day room, same day, few hours

steps.t: Create a standard one-night reservation.
Check the guest in.
Stay tab > click the Departure date > select today > set NIGHTS to zero > Save > Confirm.
Make sure the arrival and departure dates match and it shows on today's departures.

sops.title: Taking a reservation by phone
sops.kw: phone reservation, book a room, make reservation, reservation by phone

steps.t: Get the arrival and departure dates, number of guests and preferred room type.
Ask for their Hilton Honors number.
steps.hk: Skip this step at this hotel.

steps.t: Quote the rate and the cancellation policy.
In PEP: Dashboard > New Booking > dates and guests > name > Room Type and Rate Plan > Guarantee Type > Done > Book.
steps.hk: In HotelKey: Dashboard > New Booking > dates and guests > name > Room Type and Rate Plan > Guarantee Type > Done > Book.

steps.t: Send the confirmation: Actions > Review Booking > Send Confirmation Letter.

sops.script: "Thank you for calling {Hotel name}. What dates are you looking for?"

sops.title: Quoting rates
sops.kw: rates, how much, price, cost per night, quote

steps.t: Start with the best available rate.
Ask if they're an Honors member or qualify for AAA, AARP, government or military rates.
steps.hk: Ask if they qualify for AAA, AARP, government or military rates.

steps.t: Quote the rate with taxes so there are no surprises.
Rates should match hilton.com.
steps.hk: Rates should match the hotel's website.

sops.script: "Tonight's best rate is $___ plus tax. Do you have any memberships like AAA?"

sops.title: Guest says it's cheaper online
sops.kw: cheaper online, price match, expedia cheaper, better rate online

steps.t: Ask where they saw it and for which dates and room type.
If it's hilton.com, book that rate.
steps.hk: If it's our own website, book that rate.

steps.t: If it's a third-party site, explain the guest can submit a Hilton price match claim online. [CHECK: current Hilton price match process]
steps.hk: If it's a third-party site, check with a manager.

steps.t: Remind them that booking direct earns Honors points.
steps.hk: Skip this step at this hotel.

sops.script: "Booking with us directly gets you Honors points, and Hilton will match a lower price."
sops.script_hk: "Let me take a look at that rate with you."

sops.title: Discount rate ID check
sops.kw: aaa, aarp, military rate, government rate, discount id

steps.t: AAA, AARP, government and military rates need proof at check-in.
Ask for the membership card or government or military ID.
If they can't show it, change the reservation to the best available rate.

sops.script: "This rate needs your AAA card at check-in. Do you have it with you?"

sops.title: Changing a reservation
sops.kw: change reservation, modify booking, change dates, change room type

steps.t: Find it with Search Reservations.
Dates: Stay tab > click the date > adjust NIGHTS > Save > read the cost change > Confirm.
Room type: Stay tab > Room Type > pick it > Keep Current Rate, Use New Rate or Rate Override.
Third-party bookings must be changed through the site they booked on.

sops.title: Cancelling a reservation
sops.kw: cancel, cancellation, cancel reservation

steps.t: Check the cancellation policy for that rate.
If a refund is owed, it goes to a manager first, and must be done before cancelling.
Cancel Reservation > YES > Confirm > choose a reason > Done.
Give the guest the cancellation number.
If linked reservations are involved, read the prompt: cancel one, or all linked.

sops.script: "Your reservation is cancelled. Here is your cancellation number."
sops.flag: The guest wants a penalty waived. Call {AGM}.

sops.title: Advance purchase / non-refundable rates
sops.kw: advance purchase, non refundable, prepaid, cant cancel

steps.t: These rates are prepaid and can't be refunded or changed.
Check the rate on the reservation before promising anything.

Tell firefighters which rooms they're in. Don't carry anyone yourself.

sops.title: Severe winter weather
sops.kw: snow, ice, winter storm, salt

steps.t: Make sure walkways and the entrance are salted.
Help stranded guests extend their stay.
Call {AGM} if staff can't make it in.

sops.title: Bomb threat
sops.kw: bomb threat, bomb, suspicious package

steps.t: Keep the caller talking. Write down exact words, time and background noise.
Call 911 after the call.
Don't use radios or phones near a suspicious package.

sops.title: PEP is down
sops.kw: pep down, system down, pms down, cant log in

steps.t: Use paper Reg. Cards and the latest backup arrivals report.
Write down every check-in, payment and room assignment.
Make keys in {Key system} (KY-03).
Enter everything in PEP once it's back up.
steps.hk: Enter everything in HotelKey once it's back up.

steps.t: Call Hilton support (HH-10).
steps.hk: Call HotelKey support: hotelkeyapp.com/support.

sops.title: Key encoder down
sops.kw: encoder down, keys not working, cant make keys

steps.t: Make keys manually in {Key system} (KY-03).
If that also fails, escort guests to their rooms with a master key.

sops.title: Credit card machine down
sops.kw: card machine down, terminal down, cant run card

steps.t: Use the backup terminal if there is one: [FILL].
Get the card on file and run it once the machine is back.
The hotel is cashless, so cash can't replace it.

sops.title: Internet or phones down
sops.kw: internet down, phones down, wifi down, no internet

steps.t: Call the internet provider: [FILL: name and number].
Use the backup phone: [FILL].
Tell guests if Wi-Fi is down and when it should be back.

sops.title: Hotel Gmail
sops.kw: gmail, email, hotel email

steps.t: Check the hotel Gmail through your shift.
Reply to guest questions within [FILL: hours].
Forward group and sales emails to the sales director.

sops.title: Answering the phone
sops.kw: phone, answer phone, greeting, transfer

steps.t: Answer within 3 rings.
Greeting: "Thank you for calling {Hotel name}, this is ___. How can I help you?"
Transfer calls to rooms without giving out room numbers.
Take messages with name, number and time.

sops.script: "Thank you for calling {Hotel name}, this is ___. How can I help you?"

sops.title: Phishing and cyber safety
sops.kw: phishing, scam call, fake email, password

steps.t: Watch for fake emails or calls claiming to be Hilton, an OTA or IT.
steps.hk: Watch for fake emails or calls claiming to be HotelKey, an OTA or IT.

steps.t: Never share your password or log someone in remotely.
Report anything suspicious to a manager.

sops.title: Who to call for what
sops.kw: who to call, contacts, phone numbers, manager number, escalate

steps.t: Fire or life-threatening: 911 first, then {Engineer} and {GM}.
Guest issues: {AGM} first, then {GM}.
Housekeeping: {Head Housekeeper}.
Above the GM: {COO}.
PEP problems: Hilton support (HH-10). Vendors: {Log book app} vendor list.
steps.hk: HotelKey problems: HotelKey support (hotelkeyapp.com/support). Vendors: {Log book app} vendor list.

sops.title: Undo a check-out
sops.kw: undo checkout, reopen reservation, checked out by mistake

steps.t: Only works on the same day as the departure.
Departures > open the reservation (status Checked Out).
Undo Check-Out (or Actions > Undo Check-Out) > Confirm.
Check it shows In-House again. Folio and charges stay as they were.

sops.title: Do Not Move (room lock)
sops.kw: do not move, lock room, room lock

steps.t: Open the reservation > Stay tab. Assign a room first if needed.
Click the lock icon > remarks > Do Not Move. A dark lock means locked.
To unlock: click the lock > remarks > Unlock Room.
Locked rooms can't be moved or have departure dates changed.

sops.title: Pre-arrival card validation batch
sops.kw: batch validation, pre arrival, validate cards, authorize arrivals

steps.t: Dashboard > More > Batch Process > Pre-Arrival Credit Card Validation > Run.
Pick the Business Date (up to 7 days ahead) > Yes, Validate Pre-Arrivals.
When it finishes, click View next to failed cards. Export or print the list.
Call those guests, then fix each card on its Folio or Payment Source.

sops.title: Web payment links
sops.kw: payment link, web link, email payment

steps.t: Folio tab > Other Payments > Web Payment Links > Create New.
Pick the payment type and check Payer Name and Payer Email.
Payment Amount (minimum $1) and Expire After Days > Create > Send.
Nothing is charged until the guest completes it.

sops.title: Room status changes
sops.kw: room status, mark clean, mark dirty, ready for guest, inspected

steps.t: Mark Dirty: Ready Rooms tile > room > Mark Dirty.
Cleaned: Dirty Rooms tile > room > Ready for Inspection.
Inspected: Dirty Rooms tile > room > Ready for Guest.
A room must be inspected before it can be Ready for Guest.

sops.title: Discrepant room status
sops.kw: discrepant, discrepancy, room has an open discrepancy

steps.t: PEP flags rooms where housekeeping says occupied but PEP says vacant. Check-in to that room is blocked.
More > Housekeeping > DISCREPANT > open the room.
Find out who's really in the room before clearing it.
If empty: Occupancy Status > Housekeeping OCCUPIED row > Remarks > Confirm Vacant.
If you can't clear it, assign the arrival another room.

sops.title: Stay remarks and reminders
sops.kw: stay remarks, notes, reservation notes, reminder

steps.t: Stay Remarks: open the reservation > Stay tab > Stay Remarks > type > Save.
Use them for anything the next shift needs to see on that reservation.

sops.title: Sending a confirmation letter
sops.kw: confirmation letter, send confirmation, confirmation email

steps.t: Open the reservation > Actions > Review Booking.
Send Confirmation Letter > Primary Email > Send, or Custom for another address.

sops.title: Additional guests and adult/child counts
sops.kw: additional guest, add guest, adult count, child count

steps.t: Update the adult and child count first for in-house guests.
Guest tab > Additional Guests > First Name and Last Name > Done.
An adult 21 or older must be added for guests under 21.

sops.title: Extra folios and charge routing
sops.kw: charge routing, extra folio, company pays room

steps.t: Folio tab > Add Folio.
Charge Routing Setup > pick the charge category > assign it to the new folio > X.
On the new folio: Add > Add New Payment Method.

sops.title: Posting a manual charge
sops.kw: post charge, add charge, manual charge, fee

steps.t: In House > reservation > Folio tab > Charge.
Tick the charge type, enter the amount > Next.
Check Charge Period, Quantity and one-time vs recurring > Next.
Look for "Charge added successfully".

sops.title: Force availability and overbooking
sops.kw: force availability, overbook, override sold out

steps.t: Manager approval first.
Availability > Rate Plan > Search Rate Plan > Force Availability, or Rate Plan > Allow Overbooking.
To change the rate after: Stay tab > edit above Total For Stay > Rate Override Reason (required) > Save.

sops.title: Audit log
sops.kw: audit log, who changed, history

steps.t: Open the reservation > Stay tab > Actions > Audit Log.
It shows who changed what and when.

sops.title: Proforma invoice
sops.kw: proforma, estimate, preliminary invoice, quote invoice

steps.t: Open the reservation > Folio tab > pick the folio > Gear icon > Print Proforma Invoice.
Tell the guest it's an estimate; the final bill can differ.
